content: Fixed timestep (Gaffer Fix Your Timestep, Jakub Tomsu): accumulator drained in whole fixed steps only; never a final partial step (breaks determinism); render either interpolates previous/current (one tick latency) or simulates a throwaway copy forward by the remainder (no latency, needs cheap state copy); inputs accumulated per frame and handed to fixed ticks; entity update order and seeds must be fixed; replay = initial state + input history.
